baseline.note: Few-view gsplat baseline on the identical split/init (name suggestion baseline3dgs-llff-fewview3-10000). Paper's 3DGS row: horns 17.59, fortress 21.25, room 21.61 PSNR. Optionally also 30000 steps (3DGS default) since the paper does not state the 3DGS iteration count.

llff-fewview3._doc: FSGS/CoR-GS/AD-GS 3-view LLFF: explicit train/val/test lists in transforms.json (test = every 8th sorted image, train = 3 uniform np.linspace+round of the rest, val = unused images, never used for selection). Images: full-res images/ PIL-bicubic /4 -> 1008x756 PNG. Init: COLMAP 3.9.1 point_triangulator + patch_match_stereo/stereo_fusion on the 3 training views only. Built by reproductions/ad-gs/tools/prepare_llff_fewview.py (COLMAP env: conda env 'colmap'); NOT rebuildable by bench.py prepare (colmap_to_transforms.py would use all-view SfM points).

notes: Use --num-gaussians 10000000 (keep all MVS init points). ~0.2 s/step on a shared A6000 => ~35-40 min per scene. Evaluation background black (official) for ad-gs; gsplat baseline uses white.
